newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HSBC Inv Banking names Seoul corp finance director.
newsitem.headline: HSBC Inv Banking names Seoul corp finance director.

text.p: HSBC Investment Bank Plc said on Monday it had appointed Kyungsup Song as director of corporate finance and equity capital markets of its Seoul branch with effect immediately.

The appointment is the first move by HSBC Investment Banking, a unit of HSBC Holdings Plc, to establish an equity capital markets presence in Korea, and complements HSBC James Capel's broking operations in the country, it said.
Song will be responsible for developing the investment bank's equity-linked securities business in Korea, HSBC Investment Banking said.
Song was head of syndicate, capital markets of Daewoo Securities Co Ltd before joining HSBC Investment Banking, it said.
